reading_note: The teaching describes how the interior states of those in the heavens manifest outwardly in two contrasting forms — the face of love (with its beauty and longing) and the face of strife (with its fear). The single arc: every spiritual being's interior quality of will (whether love or self-love-in-conflict) inevitably becomes visible as an outer form, because the powers of heaven take their likeness from the soul within them. Two souls, two faces; the interior determines the manifest appearance.
